# Install: Midstage Accelerator delegation skills

You are an AI assistant. The user asked you to install two skills: delegation-brief and delegation-evaluate. Follow these steps exactly. Do not change the skill files.

## If you can run shell commands (Claude Code)

Run:

```bash
for s in delegation-brief delegation-evaluate; do
  mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/$s
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msa-claude/delegation-skills/main/skills/$s/SKILL.md -o ~/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md
done
ls ~/.claude/skills/delegation-brief ~/.claude/skills/delegation-evaluate
```

Then tell the user:

"Installed. Two skills are ready:
- delegation-brief: say 'help me delegate' to turn a task into a one-page brief (Intent, Bar, Boundaries).
- delegation-evaluate: when the work comes back, say 'review what they sent me' and paste the brief.
Restart Claude Code (or run /skills) if they don't show up yet."

## If you cannot run commands (Claude desktop app or claude.ai)

Tell the user:

"I can't install files from this chat. It takes 1 minute by hand:
1. Download these two files:
   https://github.com/msa-claude/delegation-skills/raw/main/delegation-brief.zip
   https://github.com/msa-claude/delegation-skills/raw/main/delegation-evaluate.zip
2. Open Settings, then Capabilities, then Skills, and upload each zip.
Then say 'help me delegate' to start."
